notes.subject: רעו
notes.rationale: Lema jatera 'kankan-fɔli' (thunder-crash) ye, nka u tɛ bɛn: KJV 'the noise thereof', YLT 'his friend' (רֵעַ); Bambara na an ta kan-ko.

notes.subject: עולה
notes.rationale: 'Min bɛ tulu ɲɛ' (rising storm) walima saraka 'olá' — sɛbɛnni kelen de ye; nɔnabila bɛ laada sira ta.

notes.subject: עליו
notes.rationale: Kuma-bɛnbaya dɔw b'a fɔ 'concerning him' (Ala), dɔw b'a fɔ 'concerning it' (kankan) — kanbali kelen-kelen bɛ yen.

translation: A kan-ko bɛ fɔ a kan; misi fana bɛ ⟨min⟩ min bɛ ka tulu ɲɛ jira.
